# m3e-rust-ui

> Material 3 Expressive components for Dioxus (Rust, WebAssembly). Components are library exports
> used as they are, not copied into apps. Colors are Material roles generated from a seed color
> with material-colors (a port of Material Color Utilities). All component CSS is bundled in the
> crate and injected by `ThemeProvider`. Version 0.1.0; semantic versioning, see docs/versioning.md.

Use it as a Cargo dependency pinned to a tag:
`m3e-rust-ui = { git = "https://github.com/sidalihallak/m3e-rust", tag = "v0.1.0" }`

Requirements: Rust 1.97 or newer; target `wasm32-unknown-unknown` for web; Dioxus 0.7 with the
`web` feature; Dioxus CLI 0.7.10 for `dx serve` and `dx build`.

## Quick start

- [Quick start](docs/quick-start.md): create a Dioxus app that uses the crate, and run it.
- [Consumer example](examples/consumer/README.md): a full app with many components.
- [README](README.md): project overview and verification index.

## Required usage

1. Wrap the app once in `ThemeProvider` (it injects every component stylesheet and the tokens).
2. Pick a seed color and mode with `ThemeSettings`.
3. Use components from the crate root, for example `Button`, `TextField`, `Card`, `Tabs`.
4. Do not copy or edit component source, and do not link component CSS files: the crate bundles them.

```rust
use dioxus::prelude::*;
use m3e_rust_ui::{Button, ButtonVariant, ColorMode, ThemeProvider, ThemeSettings};

#[component]
fn App() -> Element {
    rsx! {
        ThemeProvider {
            default_theme: ThemeSettings { seed: 0xff6750a4, mode: ColorMode::System, ..Default::default() },
            Button { variant: ButtonVariant::Filled, "Hello" }
        }
    }
}
```

## Theme

- `ThemeSettings { seed, mode, variant, contrast }`: `seed` is an ARGB u32 (`0xff6750a4`);
  `mode` is `ColorMode::Light | Dark | System`; `variant` is a `ThemeVariant` (TonalSpot by default);
  `contrast` is a `ThemeContrast`.
- `use_theme()` returns a signal of the nearest provider's settings. Update it with `with_mut`.
- `ThemeScope` themes a subtree independently. `ImageThemePicker` picks a seed from an image.
- Material roles are CSS variables such as `--md-sys-color-primary`. They are written on the
  provider's element, so set overrides on an element inside the provider.
- `theme::ThemePreview::from_seed(seed)` returns the light and dark `Scheme` values.

## Styles

- `M3eStyles` injects the bundled component CSS. `ThemeProvider` renders it, so apps need not.
- `component_css()` returns the joined CSS string; `COMPONENT_CSS` lists the source files.
- `tailwind.css` is an optional Tailwind v4 mapping for apps that use Tailwind. Components do not need it.

## Components (exported from the crate root)

- Actions: Button, StandardButtonGroup, ConnectedButtonGroup, SplitButton, IconButton,
  Fab, FabMenu, Chip, Checkbox, Radio, RadioGroup, Switch, Slider, SegmentedButton, SegmentedButtonSet,
  Toggle, ToggleGroup.
- Inputs: TextField, Input, Textarea, Label, Field, FieldSet, FieldGroup, InputGroup, InputOTP,
  Select, NativeSelect, Combobox, Autocomplete, DatePicker, DatePickerModal, Calendar, TimePicker.
- Surfaces and feedback: Card, Divider, Dialog, AlertDialog, BottomSheet, SideSheet, Sheet, Popover,
  Tooltip, RichTooltip, HoverCard, Menu, DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Alert, Snackbar, Toast, Toaster,
  NotificationBadge, BadgeAnchor, EmptyState, Skeleton, LoadingPlaceholder, LinearProgress,
  CircularProgress, LoadingIndicator, Spinner.
- Navigation: AppBar, Toolbar, NavigationBar, NavigationRail, ModalNavigationRail, NavigationLayout,
  Tabs, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Menubar, NavigationMenu, Sidebar (SidebarProvider), Command, CommandDialog.
- Content and data: List, Item, Accordion, Collapsible, Table, DataTable, Chart, Carousel,
  ExpressiveCarousel, Avatar, AvatarGroup, Kbd, Marker, Message, MessageScroller, Bubble, Attachment,
  Questionnaire, AspectRatio, ScrollArea, ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle.
- Icons: Icon (`IconData`, `icons` module with rounded, outlined and sharp glyphs), MaterialSymbol.

Component props are plain Rust structs generated by `#[component]`; see each module in `src/components/`.
Event callbacks are `EventHandler` values, and values are controlled through `Signal`s.

## Accessibility and motion

- Native elements carry semantics (buttons, inputs, radios, checkboxes, tabs with `role="tab"`).
- Reduced motion is honored by the bundled CSS (`prefers-reduced-motion`).
- Desktop browser checks are recorded in docs/*-verification.md. Android and screen-reader checks are not complete.

## Rules for agents

- Use components unmodified. Do not copy their source into an app.
- Follow the protocol in docs/component-development.md before adding or changing a component.
- Record public API changes in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased.
- Keep AGENTS.md's project boundaries: the rskit-ui implementation is out of scope.
